profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Suralink | AI Platform

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Applied AI
positions.description:
- Contributed to the development of an NLP-based order management software orchestration service.
- Developed and integrated automated order management solution with a Fortune 500 client’s POS software and hardware, leading to additional IoT/AI-based contract deals and being awarded the ‘2019 IDEA Award’.
- Crafted data-driven dashboards for executive-level management enabling analytics and health, performance, equipment, and supply-chain monitoring of an IoT and AI-based industrial automation offering.
- Integrated real-time chat functionality for a Fortune 500 health insurance company, improving agent-to-customer response time/throughput by 43%.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Node.js · Redux.js · HTML5 · WebSocket · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Vue.js · React.js · PostgreSQL · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with product, business, design, and quality assurance teams in the development of Science 37’s decentralized clinical research web application, NORA.
- Established code review, unit testing, documentation, continuous integration, Slack integration, and automated code linting for the client engineering team, improving team-wide productivity by 38%.
- Inspired tech department-wide hackathons stemming from a week-long NORA 2.0 hackathon with a colleague, eventually leading to the redevelopment of NORA.
- Led development and architecture of NORA 2.0, improving release frequency, compliance, and quality assurance.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · Node.js · Redux.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MySQL · Express.js · React.js
